description: The forward links of an original battery passport: one link per new passport that the original issuer added after the notification of a new passport.

Text.description: Describes a Property which contains plain text. This is intended exclusively for human readable strings, not for identifiers, measurement values, etc.

UuidV4Trait.description: The provided regular expression ensures that the UUID is composed of five groups of characters separated by hyphens, in the form 8-4-4-4-12 for a total of 36 characters (32 hexadecimal characters and 4 hyphens), optionally prefixed by "urn:uuid:" to make it an IRI.

BpnlTrait.description: The provided regular expression ensures that the BPNL is composed of prefix 'BPNL', 10 digits and two alphanumeric letters.

OperationEnumeration.description: The four operations after which a new passport is issued.

Timestamp.description: Describes a Property which contains the date and time with an optional timezone.

SuccessorLink.description: The link from an original passport to one new passport.

passportIdentifier.description: The digitalProductPassportId of the new passport.

catenaXId.description: The catenaXId of the new twin.

secondLifeOperatorBpnl.description: The BPNL of the second-life operator.

operation.description: The operation that issued the new passport.

operationDate.description: The date the new passport was issued.

SuccessorsCharacteristic.description: The list of the forward links of an original passport.

successors.description: One entry per new passport to which the original issuer added a forward link.
